name: Niger

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of orange, white and green, with an orange disc in the centre of the white stripe; the flag is nearly square.
flag.symbolism: Orange represents the Sahara in the north, white purity and hope, and green the fertile south and the Niger River; the disc represents the sun.

hook: Niger looks like India with a plain orange sun instead of a blue wheel, on a nearly square flag.
trivia: Niger's flag has unusual proportions of 6:7, making it almost square.
Niger has the highest fertility rate in the world.
